The checkout page treated the welcome discount coupon as invalid, so the welcome discount was not applied and the required discount amount was not shown.
Check the checkout coupon rules and the welcome10 promotion setup. Restore acceptance of the welcome coupon and confirm that it shows the 10% success message and a $2.80 discount for this $28 order.
